prompt: Create ONE open student dossier as TRUE coarse low-resolution 32-bit-era PIXEL ART. Large square pixel blocks, clear stepped contour, sparse simple clustered shading, dark walnut spine, small muted brass rings and teal cloth cover. Two wide completely BLANK IVORY PAPER pages are solid opaque flat cream color; no patterns, no stains, no dirt, no translucent spots, no erased writing, no gradients within the pages. Front facing camera-parallel pages and thin lower paper edge. Visually approximately 120 art pixels across the entire book, magnified crisp square pixels. No hand painting, no wood grain, no fabric noise, no smooth curves, no blur, no high-resolution detail. Fully opaque object. Place it on a perfectly flat uniform saturated bright MAGENTA (#FF00FF) chroma-key background. Background has no texture, no shadow, no glow, no gradients. No magenta anywhere on the book itself. Whole book inside frame with generous magenta margin. This is game sprite raw material; no scene, no letters, no text.
